expectations.text: The chart is in a fenced code block (so it stays aligned)
If the chart is framed, every line has the same display width
Only font-safe glyphs (ASCII, Latin-1, WGL4 box drawing, shades, half blocks, markers)
Each share is given as a correct percentage (±0.6 points)
The shares are drawn in proportion: a 100% stacked bar with segments ±1 cell, or a pie of 6+ rows
